index.introduction: F-Droid d akatalug yettwasebdaden n yisnasen n iseɣzanen illelliyen neɣ n uɣbalu yeldin ɣef tetiknulujit Android. Amsaɣ ad yessifses tunigin, asebded akked uḍfaṛ n ileqman ɣef yibenk-ik.
index.screenshot: Tuṭṭfa n ugdil n usnas Android F-Droid
index.title: D acu-t F-Droid ?

package.anti_features_warning: Asnas-ayi degs kra n timahilin yezmer ur ten tḥemmelḍ ara.
package.author: Ameskar
package.minimum_android_version: Lqem-agi ilaq as Android {{ android_version }} neɣ ugar.
package.signed_by_fdroid: Yebna udiɣ yezmel sɣur F-Droid, yettwaḍmen akken ad imeɣru d d uɣbalu-agi n uɣbaṛ.
package.suggest_downloading_via_fdroid: Ɣas akken asider n APK yella ddaw-a, ẓer d akken ma tesbeddeḍ asnas s tarrayrt-agi, ur d-tremseḍ ara ar zdat ilɣa udiq d tarrayt ur nerkid ara i usider. Yelha limer ad tesbeddeḍ amsaɣ F-Droid i waya.

permissions.permdesc_acceptHandovers: Sireg asnas ad ikemmel asiwel i yekkren deg usnas-nniḍen.
permissions.permdesc_accessBackgroundLocation: Ma yella tettunefk tsiregt-nniḍen n unekcum ɣer wadig iqerben neɣ usdid, asnas izmer ad yekcem ɣer wadig-ik deg lawan anida yettwaselkam deg ugilal.
permissions.permdesc_accessCoarseLocation: Asnas-a izmer ad yawi adig ɣef akken llan yiɣbula n uẓeṭṭa am texxamin n tiliqriyin n ufus akked iẓedwa Wi-Fi, maca ala ma yella usnas yettwaselkam deg ugilal. Imeẓla-a n usideg ilaq ad remden daɣne ad ttwakcamen deg tiliɣri-ik akken asnas ad yizmir ad ten-yesseqdec.
permissions.permdesc_accessDrmCertificates: Ad yeǧǧ asnas ad d-imudd daɣen ad iseqdec iselkinen DRM. Mačči d ayen ara ilaqen ilebda i yisnasen imugna.
permissions.permdesc_accessFineLocation: Asnas-a izmer ad d-yaf adig usdid ala ma yella iban-d s wudem. Imeẓla-a n usideg ilaq ad ttwaremden deg tiliɣri-ik akken asnas ad yizmir ad ten-iseqdec. Aya izmer ad yesnerni učči n uẓru.
permissions.permdesc_accessImsCallService: Ad isireg asnas ad iseqdec ameẓlu IMS akken yeg isawalen mebla taguri n ufus.
permissions.permdesc_accessLocationExtraCommands: Ad isireg asnas ad yekcem ɣer tludna-nniden n usideg. Aya izmer ad yeǧǧ asnas ad d-iger iman-is akken tiddin n GPS neɣ iɣbula-nniḍen n usideg.
permissions.permdesc_accessNetworkConditions: Ad yeǧǧ asnas ad isɣed i uqareɛ n tewtilt n uzeṭṭa. Ur ilaq ara i yisnasen menwala.
permissions.permdesc_accessNetworkState: Ad yeǧǧ asnas ad yekcem ɣef telɣut n tuqqniwin n uẓeṭṭa, am yiẓedwa yellan daɣen qqnen.
permissions.permdesc_accessNotifications: Ad yeǧǧ isnasen ad d-awin, ad selḍen daɣen ad sirgen ilɣa, ula d wid i d-uznen isnasen-nniḍen.
permissions.permdesc_activityRecognition: Asnas-a izmer ad iɛqel armud-ik•im aɣaran.
permissions.permdesc_addVoicemail: Ad isireg asnas akken ad yernu iznan ɣer tebwaṭ-ik•im n yiznan n taɣect.
permissions.permdesc_answerPhoneCalls: Ad isireg asnas akken ad yerr ɣef usawal i d-ikecmen.
permissions.permdesc_audioWrite: Ad isireg asnas akken ad ibeddel talkensit-ik•im n uẓawan.
permissions.permdesc_camera: Asnas-a izmer ad yeṭṭef tiwlafin daɣen ad issekles tvidyutin s useqdec n tkamirat deg yal akud.
permissions.permdesc_changeNetworkState: Ad isireg asnas akken ad ibeddel addad n tuqqna n uẓeṭṭa.
permissions.permdesc_enableCarMode: Ad isireg asnas akken ad irmed askar n tkeṛṛust.
permissions.permdesc_imagesWrite: Ad isireg asnas akken ad ibeddel talkensit-ik•im n tewlafin.
permissions.permlab_readPhoneState: Ɣer addad akked tamagit n timiɣri
